Heard on I.A.No.27038/2025, which is first application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellant Vijay Chaudhary.

Appellant is aggrieved of the judgment dated 28.10.2025 passed by the Exclusive Special Judge,
POCSO Act, District-Katni in SC No.39/2023, whereby learned trial Court has convicted and sentenced appellant as under :
 Conviction Sentence  Impri  Section Act Imprisonment Fine  lieu o  R.I. for 5 Rs.1000/- ( not R.I. f  366 IPC  years deposited ) month  POCSO R.I. for 20 Rs.5,000/- (not  5L r/w. 6 R.I. f  Act years deposited)
 363 and 376  Nil  (2)(n)
Learned counsel for the appellant pointed out that Dr. Huma Bhavna (PW-4) stated that she had seized a blue colour panty apart from two vaginal slides and pubic hairs of the victim.
She had handed over that to the constable, who had come.

It is pointed out that Dr. Swapnila Chouhan (DW-1), who had carried out DNA examination and found that DNA profile as was found on the Vijay Chaudhary vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 30 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/134020527/
1 panty of the victim was same as that of the appellant's blood sample and stated that he had received a black colour panty.

sentences.text: Thus, it is submitted that once the colour of panty as 2 CRA-11080-2025 was seized by the doctor then DNA report looses its significance.
There are good chances of success in the appeal.
Hence, prayer is made to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant Vijay Choudhary and to release him on bail.
Shri Arvind Singh, learned Public Prosecutor for the State, in his turn, opposes the prayer for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record, so also the fact that the appeal is going to take time for its disposal, without commenting on the merits of the case, we are of the considered opinion that this is a fit case to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant Vijay Choudhary and to release him on bail.
I.A. No.27038/2025 is accordingly allowed with respect to Vijay.

It is directed that on depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with two solvent sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on 30.03.2026 and such other dates as may be fixed by the trial court
, the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence imposed upon appellant Vijay Chaudhary shall remain suspended and he shall be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
I.A.No.27038/2025 is allowed & disposed of.
List the case for final hearing as per its turn and seniority.
Certified copy as per rules.
(VIVEK AGARWAL) (RATNESH CHANDR  JUDGE JUDG
